6.257 rsInvalidTablixHeaderSize
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidTablixHeaderSize is a critical error that occurs when the TablixHeader.Size for a tablix header
is invalid. Each header column has to be equal in total height in the TablixColumnHierarchy, and each
header row has to be equal in width in the TablixRowHierarchy.
